text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The day of the Prix Niel. At 
ParisLongchamp Racecourse, one particular 
Umamusume was drawing overwhelming 
attention.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Venus Park glided effortlessly across the 
heavy turf, winning by a margin 
unfathomable for a GⅠ race and sending the 
crowd into a frenzy.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A rival she would likely face in the Prix 
de l'Arc de Triomphe... Without being 
overwhelmed by her strength, she had to 
determine what skills were truly necessary 
in today's race.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The race in France has finally arrived. 
The curtain rises on <chrname>'s first race of the 
overseas campaign—
